comments: Basically an ever-so-slightly scaled back U6t.
Bassy and dark due to odd scoops in the upper-midrange and mid-treble.
Very well tuned just falls short in terms of resolution. Satisfying mid-bass presence.
Sounds similar to Airpods Pro but with less resolution. Easy on the ears but quite smoothed over and dark.
V-shaped with more of an emphasis on technical performance; however, tonality doesn't seem quite right.
A bit too bright sounding in the lower-treble (and brittle treble overall) which sounds odd compared to smoother lower-mids and bouncy sub-bass.
Smooth sounding but lack of treble extension leads to low-level detail and poor dynamics.
Pleasantly tuned and inoffensive; however, sounds smoothed over due to 2kHz pinna and lack of treble extension.
Good resolution and technicalities but tonality seems a bit poor: sucked lower-midrange and odd pinna gain, treble seems incoherent.
Big sound with less great execution. Warm and colored but not quite in the right ways.
Sucked out upper-midrange and lower-treble kills definition. Bass is poor. Needs work.
U-shaped with extra mid-bass. Strong focus on upper-treble leads to feathery tactilty, but quite dynamic sounding and detailed.
Colored and unconventionally tuned, in a good way, with top-tier technical performance.
Generic V-shaped tuning and generally weak technicalities.
Smoothed over and inoffensive, lacking in treble extension like the Neon Pro.
W-shaped tuning. Controlled bass boost, solid treble extension, exciting listen overall.
Sounds like a knock-off Anole VX. Farty BA bass and lack of treble extension.
Excellent bass response, just falls slightly short in control. Could use more treble extension.
Much more bloated and warm than the 2020 model, sounds too relaxed and loses its excellent tonality.
Very weird listen, lots of mid-bass and sucked-out midrange, but treble is well-extended and vibrant. Acquired taste but worth a listen.
Still muffled sounding with odd mid-treble peak, but more palatable than the Cascara and Ponderosa.
Very mid-bassy, upper-mids are recessed, and rolls off of 10kHz.
Most normal sounding Campfire IEM yet. Neutral with sub-bass boost, very pleasant on the ears but missing some mid-treble for resolution/edge.
Sounds like Andromeda 2020 with more treble extension, and everything is fine up until the mid-treble where there's a huge peak.
More muffled sounding than the Cascara and with even less treble energy (this perception possibly just owing to more bass).
Decent, seems like a small improvement over the Solaris 2020.
Heavily V-shaped while hanging onto tonal balance by a thread.
Literally sounds like balls.
Very wacky sounding midrange, BC smears the bass as well. Treble is decent and so are techs, though.
Pleasant midrange but can't remember much else about this one.
Forward, midrange-focused sound. A bit fatiguging but reminds me of a 7A Supernova with more clarity.
Sounds like Andromeda 2020 put on some serious weight.
Something of a chameleon, difficult to pin down this IEM's signature.
Wonky.
More balanced than others in this series, but still some treble irregularities and bass sounds dry.
Mediocre.
Warmer than the CE6 and more pleasing tonally as a result. Slightly less technical.
Very lean reference signature. Timbre is quite dry accordingly.
Wonky.
Treble has some unnatural peaking past 10kHz that lends to a Focal-esque, metallic tinge.
Very safe sounding overall albeit competently tuned.
Exciting and grand sounding with some tonal quirks.
Impressive imaging for a single-DD and an interesting tonality that harkens to the CRA with smoother treble.
Satisfying sub-bass thump with good tuning fundamentals moving upwards.
Technical sounding and clearly shooting for a more 'musical' focus, but treble is oddly peaky and juxtaposed weirdly to pinna rising at ~600Hz.
Bass has improved but significantly brighter than the Annihilator 2023 and a regression overall.
Reminds me of if Elysian tuned more towards 64 Audio's sound while maintaing upper-mids. Colored sound done correctly with great technicalities.
Sounds very similar to the original Apostle albeit slightly drier from memory.
Technical sounding but treble seems somewhat metallic and less balanced than pre-production unit.
Great detail pick-up and solid tuning at the expense of being somewhat strident.
Generally reminiscent of the Empire Ears EVO with a more relaxed upper-midrange and more extended upper-treble.
Conventionally L-shaped IEM with relaxed midrange and treble. Could use some more upper-treble to boost resolution.
Extremely heavy - but controlled - bass shelf with neutral midrange and treble.
See FatFreq Sakura, but with more upper-midrange and upper-treble.
Grand Maestro with an even more controlled sub-bass boost for more of a sub-woofer characteristic.
Pleasant neutral-warm tonality with lack of air over 10kHz.
Treble sounds sibilant and overall tuning is quite off-putting.
See Neon 4 but even worse b/c lack of pinna and upper-mids.
Can't tell what Kinetic bass tech is doing. Blunted and low-level detailing.
Good detail, but frequency response is contentious.
Very wonky tuning, especially in the transition between upper-midrange and lower-treble.
Tuned a little more conventionally than the Artha but still has its share of quirks.
U-shaped with some extra mid-bass. Coherency could use work between the bass and upper-treble, but pretty fun.
Thin and glassy sounding upper-midrange and excessive amounts of upper-treble. Clarity focused with poor execution.
Well-tuned neutral with bass boost signature. A bit uninspired sounding overall, though, especially in terms of excitement.
The Hyla house sound (good amounts of bass and upper-mids) but less refined.
Horribly shouty and bright.
Sounds warm and relatively pleasant, a bit QDC inspired. EST implementation rolls off and could use more texturing overall.
A more V-shaped PP8.

Mediocre.

Sounds like music being played behind tinfoil.
